lead: Casa Monarca at 206 W 26th St serves Mexican food rather than Tex-Mex, says Texas Monthly. Molcajetes, birria quesadillas and margaritas. 4.8 stars from 353 Google reviews.

about: Casa Monarca Mexican Cantina is at 206 W 26th St in Historic Downtown Bryan.
Texas Monthly notes it focuses on Mexican food rather than Tex-Mex, highlights the molcajete and warns there may be a wait on weekend nights.
It celebrated its first anniversary on April 11, 2026.
